payload.name: Appearance-change retrieval for abstract transformation queries
payload.description: When a question asks about a person's physical transformation, appearance change, or looks within a time period, retrieve concrete appearance-change event memories instead of relying on abstract query terms.
content: When the question asks about a person's physical transformation or appearance change in a time window, expand the query with concrete appearance-change phrases (dyed, cut, shaved, tattoo, pierced, glasses, gained/lost weight) and add structured or keyword searches on event memories with those terms.
If the first round returns only unrelated topical memories and no appearance-related event, run at least one more search targeting appearance terms before answering 'no information'.

solves: The failure occurs when abstract appearance wording like 'physical transformation' misses concrete appearance-change events (e.g., dyed hair) in memory search. The Skill applies when a future question asks what physical or appearance change a person underwent in a stated time window, and instructs the agent to search with concrete appearance-change terms and inspect event memories near the target date. It does not apply to ordinary event-retrieval questions that do not describe appearance changes.
